title: Quasi-compact morphisms are stable under base change
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a quasi-compact morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-finite-type-morphism] and let $g:S'\to S$ be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Form the fibre product $X':=X\times_S S'$ [def-pc-fibre-product, def-pc-base-change] and let $f':X'\to S'$ be its projection. Then $f'$ is quasi-compact.
